# finalproject

My BST260 project will be exploring the association between permitless
concealed-carry policies and state firearm mortality during 2014–2024,
using course-provided RAND and CDC datasets.

[Read the project
proposal](https://jingyiwang6.github.io/finalproject/articles/proposal.html).

# Package index

## All functions

- [`cdcfiremort`](https://jingyiwang6.github.io/finalproject/reference/cdcfiremort.md)
  : data from CDC on rates of mortality by firearm by state by year
- [`cdcmurd`](https://jingyiwang6.github.io/finalproject/reference/cdcmurd.md)
  : data from CDC on homicide rates by state by year
- [`gunleg`](https://jingyiwang6.github.io/finalproject/reference/gunleg.md)
  : data from RAND corporation on historical record of state
  legislatures actions on firearms control
- [`waterborne`](https://jingyiwang6.github.io/finalproject/reference/waterborne.md)
  : data from CDC on waterborne and foodborne illness events
